feeding_claim.verbatim: We have 100% grass fed and finished beef.

notes: Grass-based dairy and meat farm near Yoder (homepage gives Hutchinson, KS), run by Daniel and Robyn King since 2015; grass-based since the early 1990s and, per the story page, grain feeding of the cows stopped by 1996. Read homepage, our story, FAQ, membership and beef side and quarter FAQ (WebFetch summaries only, so recheck the verbatim quote). Homepage lists raw all-grass dairy, grassfed and finished beef, pastured pork, pasture-raised chicken and eggs, bone broth and tallow skin care. Story also mentions turkeys and lamb, not seen on the current product list, so left out. Raw milk is clearly stated; raw milk sales are legal only in some states. Butter and cheese come from the membership page's delivery list; not confirmed they are made from the farm's own milk or raw, so Verifier should check. Sales are only through the farm store, by appointment for the first visit with a free Bronze membership; monthly home delivery for paid Silver and Gold members in McPherson, Hesston, Wichita area and Andover. FAQ: 'We do not ship products.' Beef sides (halves) and split quarters processed at Yoder Meats, buyer pays processing. No phone on these pages (email hello@jakofarm.com). Also says it manages two local organic orchards and markets raw honey; whether honey is its own is unclear.
